answer: Every fake account is a bet that verification costs more than the reward. Signed BMX track membership with race results flips the bet — races run and timed over three seasons — and the comet lands on the attacker instead. What makes this stick is that races run and timed over three seasons cannot be faked in bulk — each proof is independent, and the nectar of independence is that one compromised proof endangers no other account. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the jade of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
